parsed.name: 显微图像数据源
parsed.description: 用于在显微镜实验中保存、读取和组织多维图像数据及其元数据的数据源对象，可管理体素尺寸、XYCZT 维度、时间点、通道和 Z 层等信息，常用于实验成像数据的存储与访问。
parsed.description_en: A data source used to store, read, and organize multidimensional microscopy image data and its metadata. It manages information such as voxel size, XYCZT dimensions, timepoints, channels, and z planes, and is commonly used for storing and accessing experimental imaging datasets.
